C-TELEGRAM-TOPIC-HYGIENE.IntentSummary: Constrain the vvoc Telegram bridge to top-level sessions with a recency-capped, delete-based topic rotation, adopt new sessions promptly through session.created plus a periodic resync and a resubscribing event pump, write plugin diagnostics to a bounded log file, and add a vvoc telegram status/log CLI surface for cross-machine diagnosis, all within the existing GRACE module ownership of M-TELEGRAM-TOPICS, M-TELEGRAM-BOT-API, M-TELEGRAM-GATEWAY, M-TELEGRAM-DELIVERY, M-TELEGRAM-CONFIG, M-PLUGIN-TELEGRAM-BRIDGE, and M-CLI-COMMANDS.

T-001.Title: Add the maxTopics rotation setting to strict schema v3, the vvoc config type, and the telegram resolver.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: schemas/vvoc/v3.json accepts telegram.maxTopics as an optional integer in 1..100 and rejects out-of-range or non-integer values with additionalProperties false preserved.
src/lib/vvoc-config.ts VvocTelegramConfig carries maxTopics and the parse/render paths round-trip it without dropping unknown-key strictness.
resolveTelegramConfig returns maxTopics defaulting to 20 and applying an explicit override.
config.test.ts covers the default and the override.

T-002.Title: Add deleteForumTopic to the Bot API transport and drop the DM-unsupported close and reopen methods.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: TelegramTransport exposes deleteForumTopic(threadId) and the raw HTTP factory shapes the deleteForumTopic payload with chat_id and message_thread_id.
closeForumTopic and reopenForumTopic are removed from the interface, the factory, and every test fake.
bot-api.test.ts asserts the deleteForumTopic payload and no longer asserts close or reopen.

T-003.Title: Rotate the topology surface: keep General plus maxTopics recent top-level sessions and delete the evicted topics.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: TelegramTopology takes maxTopics and reconcile keeps General plus at most maxTopics candidate sessions ordered by effective recency (max of the native update time and the stored bot-usage time).

Every existing session topic outside the kept set is deleted with deleteForumTopic, its topic and session rows removed, and its thread id recorded in report.deletedThreadIds; TOPIC_ID_INVALID drops the stale mapping without a failure.
General is never deleted and never counts toward the cap; TopicPassReport carries deleted and deletedThreadIds instead of closed.
topic state is a single open mapping; the close and reopen transitions are gone.
topology.test.ts proves the cap, the recency ordering, the delete cleanup, and the invalid-id tolerance.

T-004.Title: Add TelegramDelivery.forgetThread to purge mirrors, outbox records, and live stream state for an evicted topic.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: forgetThread removes in-memory and persisted mirror rows whose threadId matches, removes outbox records for that thread, and drops any stream or status-line cache entries.
delivery.test.ts proves a delivered message's mirror and a pending outbox record for the thread are both gone and other threads are untouched.

T-005.Title: Bridge only top-level sessions, adopt them on session.created, resubscribe after stream ends, and run a periodic resync.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: resync builds candidates only from sessions whose parentID is undefined and passes them to reconcile, then calls delivery.forgetThread for every deleted thread id.
The session.created handler adopts a top-level session with no topic immediately and still routes child sessions as parent-topic cards without a topic.
The event pump loops resync then subscribe with a bounded delay, so a stream end no longer terminates the pump.
A periodic resync runs on an unref'd injectable interval and is cleared on stop.
sessions.test.ts proves children never get topics, a created top-level session is adopted, and a stream end resyncs and resubscribes.

T-006.Title: Wire maxTopics and a bounded file log into the plugin assembly.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: createTelegramBridgePlugin passes resolved.maxTopics to TelegramTopology and keeps the existing startup ordering and teardown.
A new log.ts appends timestamped, token-free lines to a bounded file under the vvoc data dir with size-based rotation and is the default plugin log sink.
index.test.ts keeps passing with an injected log; log.test.ts proves append, bound, and rotation.

T-007.Title: Update the Telegram command surface for the rotated candidate set and the deleted report.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: /sync and /status build candidates from all top-level sessions without the activity-window filter and no longer reference a closed count.
The /sync reply reports created, deleted, reused, and failed counts.
commands.test.ts covers the new reply text and the top-level candidate set.

T-008.Title: Add the vvoc telegram status and vvoc telegram log CLI commands.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: vvoc telegram status resolves the effective telegram config, reports enabled or a value-free disabled reason, calls getMe for token liveness, prints the bot fingerprint, General id, topic/session/mirror counts, and offset age from the OpenCode database best-effort, warns when the config is newer than the running server, and prints a verdict; --json emits the same payload.
vvoc telegram log prints the tail of the plugin log file with an optional --lines.
Neither command ever prints the token.
telegram-status.test.ts covers an enabled report, a disabled reason, and the JSON shape with injected seams.
The commands are registered under the vvoc telegram parent in cli.ts.

T-009.Title: Update the end-to-end integration suite and run the full repository gate.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: telegram.integration.test.ts reflects the delete transport and the rotation behavior and stays deterministic without a live Telegram or native dependency.
bun run check passes with fresh output.

T-010.Title: Reconcile README and the durable GRACE projections, then release 2.3.0-rc.8.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: README documents top-level-only topics, maxTopics with delete-based rotation, the log location, and vvoc telegram status/log.

M-TELEGRAM-TOPICS, M-TELEGRAM-BOT-API, M-TELEGRAM-GATEWAY, M-TELEGRAM-DELIVERY, M-PLUGIN-TELEGRAM-BRIDGE, and M-CLI-COMMANDS purposes plus V-M-* scenarios match the shipped behavior; grace lint is clean and observed drift is explained by this change.
bun run release:bump produces 2.3.0-rc.8 and bun run release:check passes.
